notes.title: Fixed Bugs
notes.content:
Small updates to fix bugs:
[list]
[*]Adjusted the main menu screen a little to be less blurry
[*]Color lab doesn't remain on screen after completing a level
[*]Tutorial works correctly now
[*]Music levels were fixed
[/list]

notes.title: UI Update
notes.content:
This update contains some big UI changes, to buttons, backgrounds, and the color lab. These make the game more enjoyable to play for a longer time.

[list]
[*]Added 'all-on' and 'all-off' buttons to the color lab, so you can easily clear and add colors to what your trying to mix.
[*]Color Lab is also bigger to fill more space and make it easier to mix colors
[*]Changed color of background to a lightish blue instead of a gray
[*]Dynamic background is now optional inside the settings menu
[*]Changed color of level buttons to match menu screen buttons
[/list]

notes.title: Better Tutorial and In-Game Help
notes.content:
This update includes a better tutorial to help new players have an easier first time playing the game. It gives an in-depth explaination to each of the Kakuro Blend features that may have been confusing beforehand. In-game help was also added to each level, so if you ever forget what something does or why something is the way that it is, the 'Help' button in the in-level settings will give you all the info you need. That's the only 2 things for this update.

If anyone sees any bugs or issues, let me know and I will try to fix those.

The next update will be a big one, including:
[list]
[*]In-game achievements, as placeholders until I can figure out Steam achievements
[*]Sounds
[*]Scene transitions
[*]Redesigned level UI to be less gray
[*]Option to turn off the dynamic background
[/list]

notes.title: Multiple Small Updates
notes.content:
Things in this update:

- Player is now able to exit game in-level, you don't have to go back to the main menu to do it anymore
- Exit game button was taken out of the Main Menu Settings and is now separate on the Main Menu
- Can now use the 'ESC' key to go to in-level settings
- Music sliders were fixed in the in-level settings, now able to adjust volume in a level
- Music was made quieter
- All levels are available from the start now

If anyone has any problems or issues with anything, let me know and I will do my best to fix it.

Thanks,
Ryan
